messages:
Lena (AE): Quick heads-up — Nimbus POC can't finish onboarding. SSO assertion uses NameID=transient and their Okta team refuses to change it by policy. SCIM attempts show groups failing. cc @Sasha
Raj (SE): Oof. transient NameID won't let us map to email by default. Do we have their SCIM request/response?
Lena (AE): They sent this from their IdP logs:
`POST https://platform.redwood.example/scim/v2/Users -> 403 Forbidden`
`response: {
  \"message\": \"Insufficient token scopes: groups.write required\"
}`
Sasha (Onboarding): Dashboard shows their SCIM token lacks Groups:Write and Users:Write. Also the tenant doesn't consent to attributes release for group membership. I'll mark provisioning as blocked for now.
Imani (Security): We can allow Groups:Write but need the signed attr-release checkbox on the security questionnaire (audit requirement). They must confirm scope and rotate token after POC.
Lena (AE): Nimbus asked if we can just consume a `groups` SAML attribute instead of SCIM because they can add that to assertions even though NameID stays transient.
Raj (SE): Yes — we accept an assertion attribute `groups` (`<Attribute Name=\"groups\">`) as a fallback. Limit ~100 group entries per assertion. That won't do full lifecycle sync (no automated provisioning/deprovisioning).
Raj (SE): For role mapping automation (e.g., Dedicated pool role bindings), SCIM is required. Manual mapping is an option for short POC windows.
Provisioner Bot: Attempted SCIM sync: 
```
POST /scim/v2/Groups -> 403
{
  \"detail\": \"Insufficient scope: groups.write required\"
}
```
Sasha (Onboarding): Operations approved a temporary manual role assignment into a Dedicated pool for 5 business days if Nimbus agrees. To lift the block permanently, we need: 1) new SCIM token with Users:Write and Groups:Write, 2) updated SAML metadata (either NameID=email or groups attribute present), 3) signed attr-release confirmation.
Lena (AE): They also worry about cost — prefer using hosted API keys for initial functional validation to avoid Dedicated trial charges. Any objections?
Raj (SE): Hosted is fine for functional checks. Note: hosted won't replicate Dedicated throughput/latency. Recommend hosted for feature tests + 5-day Dedicated manual mapping for perf.
Imani (Security): Also request a security note: we will run a quick token scope audit once token arrives and will require rotation after POC. Tell Nimbus to include the token creation timestamp and admin who created it.
Lena (AE): I'll relay: 1) reissue SCIM token with Users:Write, Groups:Write; 2) add `groups` attribute or change NameID to email (if possible); 3) sign attr-release. I'll ask if they'd like hosted keys now and opt into the 5-day Dedicated manual mapping.
Sasha (Onboarding): Putting a checklist in the tenant ticket. If they accept manual mapping now, I can provision the Dedicated entry today. If they want automated mapping, we wait for token + metadata.
Lena (AE): Thanks — pinging Nimbus engineering and Okta admin. Will update here when they respond. /remind me in 48h to follow up. :calendar:
